title: Bomb Threat
text: Preppers in the west side area: combat roll 4+ or lose 2 HEALTH

title: Dog escapes data center
text: Roll RISK DICE. 1-2: Bitten - lose 1 HEALTH; 3-6: spend 1 FOOD to tame and keep the dog

title: Medical worker offers contraband meds
text: You may swap any 1 resource for 3 MEDS at the hospital while this event remains

title: Stab vest at pawn shop!
text: First to get there pays 1 DOOMCOIN or 1 TECH to acquire

title: Crypto price soars!
text: Any prepper with TECH may sell each for 2 DOOMCOIN

title: Med centers packed with panicking patients!
text: Hospital closed until this card is covered

title: Have hazmat suit - need food!
text: First prepper to the bar may acquire for 1 FOOD

title: Anti-tech rioters hit East Side!
text: Any prepper in the east boxed in until card is covered OR 5+ combat to escape the area

title: Airborne outbreak!
text: All preppers pay 1 MED or lose 2 HEALTH (hazmat owners shielded)

title: Emergency curfew imposed!
text: No night-time movement until this card is covered (place night dice here)

title: 'Robin Hood' AI forces crypto redistribution!
text: Poorest prepper receives 1 DOOMCOIN from all other preppers (if tied for poorest, prepper donors choose their recipient)

title: Bent building manager
text: First to reach steel plant may swap 2 TECH for solar panel

title: Powerplant pollution!
text: Preppers on or adjacent to river lose 1 MED or 1 HEALTH (hazmat owners shielded)

title: You brew "Ale-pocalypse" beer - it's good stuff!
text: Gain 2 FOOD and 2 KNOW-HOW

title: Bug-out drill test
text: Current prepper missing any resource type must scrap one item

title: Panic-buyers' bags burst!
text: Place 2 MEDS on West Street and 3 FOOD on Law Street

title: Hacker attack: all CCTV disabled
text: Caught on a 1 only when stealing or looting while this card is active

title: City-wide blackout!
text: Any prepper without a flashlight loses 1 resource

title: Ultimate dumpster dive
text: All preppers may trade all TECH for top ITEM card at recycling depot

title: PJ's yard sale
text: Buy any gun shop or hardware store item at half price (rounded down)

title: Train drops vital aid package
text: Place 1 of each resource at the train station

title: Red-hot briefcase on subway!
text: Subway stations are closed until this card is covered

title: Out-of-date food
text: Current prepper gets sick: lose 2 HEALTH or 1 MED

title: Thugs show up late for work
text: Do not feed/pay thugs while this card is active

title: Truck dumps chemical waste
text: Any prepper in central area loses 2 HEALTH (hazmat owners shielded)

title: Weapon mastery
text: Any prepper with a bow or knife: spend 1 turn training and add +2 token to chosen ITEM card

title: Dumpster dive dash
text: First prepper to reach SW dumpster takes top ITEM card

title: Civil unrest: anti-AI demonstration outside Big Data Inc
text: Place a MOB token on Bourbon Street, Park View and Riverside View. No movement on these streets unless carrying a weapon

title: Civil unrest: truckers set light to new driverless truck
text: Place a MOB token on Diesel Drive and Commercial Way. No movement on these streets unless carrying a weapon

title: Civil unrest: looting at the department store
text: Place a MOB token on Retail Road. To pass, combat 5+ (-2 HEALTH on fail) before continuing move

title: Civil unrest: anti big pharma protest at health clinic
text: Place a MOB token on Green Park Avenue and Drill Street. Combat 4+ to pass (fail: -2 HEALTH; succeed: take pistol ITEM OR avoid combat, join the mob and gain 2 MEDS)

title: Civil unrest: protest against planned oligarch bunker
text: Place a MOB token on six streets surrounding park. Bribe cops (3 DOOMCOIN) on these streets or weapon ITEM confiscated

title: Civil unrest: citizens recycling depot over nuclear waste plan
text: Place a MOB token on Turbine Drive, Rust Road, Justice Way and Fisher Street. No movement on these streets without a bolt cutters

title: Rogue robot prototypes attack police station
text: Place a MOB token on Hill Street and Law Street. Combat 5+ to defeat robots and gain drone ITEM; fail: reduce HEALTH by half (rounded up)

title: 'Unplugged': anti-AI festival in the park
text: Place a MOB token in the park. No entry/exit to park unless you own no TECH resource

title: 'Furry friends' march against animal testing
text: Place a MOB token on Bourbon Street, Hill Street and Gasoline Grove. May not pass through these streets without a dog ITEM

title: Hospital workers walk out over defective PPE
text: Place a MOB token in hospital. It is closed until card is covered. If 0 HEALTH, use MEDS or place prepper at health clinic and pay: 1 DOOMCOIN = 1 HEALTH

title: Dirty bomb threat: town-wide military lockdown
text: Each turn until this card is covered, if moving, roll RISK dice. 1-2: shot by National Guard (-3 HEALTH). Ignore if you own walkie-talkie ITEM

title: Turbine drive rooftop sniper takes law into own hands
text: Any movement on streets in south, central or north area risks being shot. Roll RISK dice. 1-2 = hit; roll again for amount of HEALTH loss taken minus armor bonuses
